About StoryIQ

Step into Last Resort, a vacation adventure shaped by your decisions. StoryIQ offers a change of pace from the collection’s logic puzzles: follow the characters and events, weigh your options, and discover where your choices lead.

How to play

  1. Read the scene and consider the available choices.
  2. Choose how to respond and follow the outcome.
  3. Continue the adventure and see how your decisions shape your vacation.
